main_body: Round pink blossom canopy on a short brown trunk, with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: No flat top band. Column x=15 runs dark outline (rows 1-4), mid pink (5-12), then a blotchy mix of light pinks and darks through row 31. The canopy is a rounded volume, not a slab with a top and a front.
evidence: The canopy is a rounded organic volume lit from the upper right. Its darker underside (rows 18-20 and 32-40 near the trunk) shades the trunk and grass below it. No flat elevation, side face, top-down slab or rim-only cap is drawn. A tree has no required horizontal surface, so the contract is met as an organic form.

style.evidence: The canopy has a 5-step pink ramp, and its dark edge pixels are tinted plum, not neutral (0% neutral). It has only 11 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The leaf clumps are large and blocky, with no per-leaf highlights or fine grain. The trunk is a plain 3-tone column and the grass is a few flat greens. Next to the references it looks much thinner and simpler.
